translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Lukas
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I LUKAS

content: Nimikirawar kuasa ni Yesus

Na sa'angu' tempo pintanga' i Yesus mimisiso' ka' mengelelekon Lele Pore men ringkat na Alaata'ala bona mian biai' men na Laiganna Alaata'ala, isian tanaasna imam, wawa ukum Torat, tia motu-motu'a notaka indo'o.
Raaya'a norobu ni Yesus taena, “Io, bantilkon na ko'omai se' upa a pimpu'uaan nangawawau men koiya'a? Ka' ime a nantarai i Koo kuasa mbali' nangawawau giigii' iya'a?”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Yaku' uga' mingkira' mimikirawar na ko'omuu. Pinginti'imuu,
Yohanes nansarani mian nimpu'u na kuasa ni ime, Alaata'ala kabai mian?”
Raaya'a nopootunduniimo kasi taena i raaya'a, “Kalu kita mangaan, ‘Kuasana ringkat na Alaata'ala,’ mbaka' simbation-Na, ‘Nongko'upa i kuu se' kosian mamarasaya upa men taeni Yohanes?’
Kasee kalu kita mangaan, ‘Nimpu'u na kuasana mian,’ giigii' mian karaale'e bo mangalapak i kita tia watu, gause i raaya'a mamarasaya se' i Yohanes mase nabii.”
Mbaka' ia simbati i raaya'a taena, “Sian inti'ionmai.”
Mbaka' norobumo i Yesus na ko'ona i raaya'a tae-Na, “Kalu koiya'a Yaku' uga' sian mambantilkon na ko'omuu se' kuasa ni ime bo pimpu'uan-Ku mangawawau koiya'a.”
Timbaani' papalimang na ale'na anggur

Kasi i Yesus nuntundunkon na ko'ona i raaya'a timbaani' men koi kani'imari: “Isian sa'angu' mian no'ale' ka' ale'na ia asoki anggur. Ale' iya'a ia tamboikonmo na toropii mian papalimang, kasi ia nomae' na lipu' sambana ka' nodumodongo pataka nanau'.

Temponamo pumpupuan woo'na anggur iya'a, tombono ale' iya'a nomosuu'mo tutulungina mae' na papalimangna ale'na iya'a mama'ase' obosna ule'na. Kasee papalimang iya'a tongko' numukul tutulungi iya'a ka' nomosuu' nomae' tia lima sompulo'.
Mbaka' tombono ale' iya'a nomosuu'mo sa'angu' tutulungina men sambana. Kasee iapo uga' tongko' nipukul ka' ia iroki papalimang iya'a, kasi niposuu' mule'kon tia lima sompulo'.
Tombono ale' iya'a nomosuu'mo soosoodo tutulungi men kotolu'na. Kasee iapo uga' tongko' ia pukul i raaya'a ka' nitibarkon waale'e na liwana ale' iya'a.
Komburi'na tombono ale' iya'a norobumo taena, ‘Upa a men tio bo wawauonku soosoodo? Yaku' bo momosuu' anakku men kolingu'ku. Sabole ia kolayaonna i raaya'a!’

Kasee tempo papalimangna ale' iya'a nimiile' anakna iya'a, raaya'a nopootunduniimo taena, ‘Iamo kaya'a a men bo pontombonoi giigii' upana tamana. Mai kita papateia i ia kada' kitamo a pontombonoi budelna.’

Mbaka' ia tibarkonmo i raaya'a a anak iya'a waale'e na liwana ale' kasi nipapatei.” Yesus nimikirawarmo na ko'ona i raaya'a tae-Na, “Koi upa a tombono ale' iya'a? Upamo a wawauonna na papalimangna ale'na iya'a?

Sabole ia bo taka ka' mampapatei papalimang iya'a, kasi mongorookon ale' iya'a na papalimang men sambana.” Nongorongor men koiya'a, mian biai' norobumo na Ko'ona taena, “Ansee, amo' sida a men koiya'a!”
Yesus nintiokimo i raaya'a kasi nangaan tae-Na, “Kalu koiya'a, upa aratina isiina Alkitaap men koi kani'imari:

content.text: nosidamo watu tuko men bo pandasi’?

content: Ime a men mandawo' na watu iya'a bo koraso-raso', ka' ime a men utunonna watu iya'a bo magampial.”

Kasi wawa ukum Torat ka' tanaasna imam nampari-pari mangarakop i Yesus na tempopo iya'a, gause ia inti'i se' tundunan ni Yesus umba'a mintimbaani'kon i raaya'a koi papalimang ale'na anggur men ba'idek. Kasee i raaya'a layaonkon mian biai'.
Mambayar pajak bona Kaisar

Wawa ukum Torat ka' tanaasna imam iya'a nanganasaimo i Yesus. Raaya'a nomosuu'mo mian men mimpipiile'kon tatakana koi se' mian maloos, mimikirawari i Yesus kada' Ia sala' wurung, kasi i raaya'a nangarakop ka' namarawootkon i Yesus na gubernuur.

Mbaka' i raaya'a men niposuu' norobumo ni Yesus taena, “Guru, kai inti'i se' giigii' men Kuu ngaan ka' Kuu pisiso'kon iya'a tuutuu', ka' i Kuu sian momposasala'kon mian, kasee i Kuu mimisiso'kon pingkira'na Alaata'ala men tuutuu'na.
Kalu na aturanna agamanta, daa patalaion a mambayar pajak bona Kaisar
kabai sian?”
Kasee ia inti'i i Yesus se' i raaya'a tongko' monsosoolani wurung-Na. Mbali' iya'a, Ia norobu tae-Na,
“Pipiile'kon na Ingku' sa'angu' doi' dinar. Gambar tia ngaan ni ime ini'i?” Ia simbati i raaya'a taena, “Gambar tia ngaanna Kaisar!”
Taeni Yesus, “Kalu koiya'a, rookon bona Kaisar a upa men tio rookononmuu na Kaisar, ka' rookon bona Alaata'ala a upa men tio rookononmuu na Alaata'ala.”
Wawa ukum Torat ka' tanaasna imam iya'a sian nandapot monsosoolani i Yesus tempo i Ia norobu potorongor mian biai'. Raaya'a nimporokotmo ka' nosamba'konmo pinsimbati ni Yesus.
Mian Saduki nimikirawar ni Yesus too mian lapus dauga' potuo'ion
Mbaka' notakamo ni Yesus a toropii mian Saduki men koi na pinginti'ina se' mian lapus sianmo tumuo' soosoodo. Raaya'a nimikirawar ni Yesus taena i raaya'a,

“Guru! Musa nuntulis ukum men koi kani'imari bo ko'onta': Kalu sa'angu' mian moro'one lapus namarerei boroki' men sian anakon, mbaka' utusna moro'one iya'a tio mosuo' tia baluna utusna kada' utusna isian lee'na.
Isian pitu' moro'one moto'utus. Men balaki'na nosuo' tia sa'angu' wiwine, kasee pataka nolapus ia sian no'anakon.
Kasi utusna men korua'na nosuo' tia baluna, kasee i iapo uga' nolapus ka' sian no'anakon.
Koiya'a uga' a utusna men kotolu'na pataka men kopitu'na. Pitu-pitu'na nomosuo'i kasee sian no'anakon.
Komburi'na wiwine iya'a uga' nolapusmo'.
Na ilio pomotuo'ian mian lapus, wiwine iya'a se' boroki' ni ime? Gause pitu-pitu' irana nompoboroki'mo i ia.”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Mian men tumuo' tempo koini'i dauga' mosuo' ka' poposuo'on,
kasee mian men daa sida bo potuo'ion moko daa lapus ka' tumuo' na tempo men bo rumpakion, raaya'a sian mosuo' ka' sian poposuo'on.
Raaya'a sianmo lapus gause koikoimo malaa'ikat. Raaya'a mase anakna Alaata'ala, gause nipotuo'imo.

Musa isian nangaan se' mian lapus bo potuo'ion. Na tulisanna men muntundunkon kau morio' ruri'on men kumait iya'a, Musa nangaan se' Tumpu iya'a Alaata'ala ni Abraham, Alaata'ala ni Ishak ka' Alaata'ala ni Yakub.
Ia taasi' Alaata'alana mian lapus, kasee i Ia Alaata'alana mian tumuo'! Gause na pimiile'na Alaata'ala, giigii' mian sianta men lapus.”
Toropii wawa ukum Torat norobu taena, “Guru, pore tuu' a ninsimbati-Muu.”
Mbali' iya'a, raaya'a sianmo momoko nimikirawar upa-upa ni Yesus.
Pookantangan ni Daud tii Tomundo' Pansalamatkon
Yesus nimikirawarmo na ko'ona i raaya'a tae-Na, “Na pinginti'imuu, nongko'upa mbali' a mian se' mangaan Tomundo' Pansalamatkon iya'a lee' ni Daud?
Poali i Daud uga' nangaan na kitap Mazmur taena,

content.text: pataka Yaku' mompoporungku' giigii' mian men mangka'idek i Koo sida malolo' na Ko'oom.’

content: Daud nangaan se' Tomundo' Pansalamatkon iya'a Tumpuna. Pinginti'imuu, koi upa a kosidana se' daa Tomundo' Pansalamatkon uga' bo lee'na?”
Ururan ni Yesus kada' maka'amat na wawa ukum Torat
Tempo giigii' mian dauga' pintanga' momorongori i Yesus, Ia norobumo na murit-Na tae-Na,

“Kuu tio maka'amat na wawa ukum Torat. Raaya'a na sasayoan mingkira' mojuba men alayo' ka' beleskon angga'ionna mian na pasar. Raaya'a mingkira' umoruang na oruangan men porena na laigan bakitumpuan kabai na pootatakaianna mian biai'.
Raaya'a mangakalkon balu wiwine ka' mangarampasi laiganna. Raaya'a mingirimboroi gau' ba'idekna tia sambayang biai' taa'! Ukumannasi a marepana tia ukumanna mian sambana!”
